mentions.name: peek-cli
mentions.description: A command-line tool that lets coding agents see the browser, giving AI coding agents visibility into the consequences of their actions.
mentions.problem: Modern coding agents code blind; they can't see the consequences of their actions.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Modern coding agents code blind; they can't see the consequences of their actions. I built a cheap solution that lets them see your browser.

It's called peek-cli: https://github.com/puffinsoft/peek-cli
